summary: Describes how a presence user agent can publish only the changed parts of its presence information to a presence server using SIP. Normally every publication carries the complete state, even for a tiny change, which is wasteful for large presence documents. Sending just the differences makes updates smaller and cheaper.

eli5.summary: Instead of rewriting your whole status board every time one line changes, you just correct the one line and tell the server about it. That keeps your updates short and quick.

questions: how to publish presence changes only
